meta.title: Close PGLite instances immediately after query execution
meta.body_summary: Refactor PGLite instance manager to create and close instances per query instead of session‑based caching to reduce memory usage.

perf_labels.notes: Devin refactored PGLite instance management to release memory; maintainer questioned DDL re‑execution overhead, clarified in discussion, and merged without benchmarks.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: A small, focused change (82 lines, mostly deletions) to simplify instance lifecycle. Typical for an incremental memory‑saving perf PR; the merged outcome is consistent.

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainer MH4GF approved but asked 'will DDL need to be run each time?', questioning whether repeated instance creation would add overhead.
review_details.performance_claim: Close PGLite instances immediately after query execution to reduce memory accumulation.
review_details.antipattern_addressed: session_pinned_resource_retention (prior session‑pinned cache, not in enum)

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Agent delivered a memory‑saving refactor with only a narrative claim and a screenshot; maintainer challenged the design trade‑off, and after a human‑driven explanation it was accepted without hard evidence.

detection_detail.code_reading: MH4GF reviewed the new per‑query instance creation and flagged the possible cost of repeated DDL execution.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No before/after memory measurements; only a screenshot of the PR body and a narrative statement about reduced memory.

core_change_summary.description: In PGliteInstanceManager.ts, removed session‑based instance Map and cleanup interval; executeQuery now creates a fresh PGLite instance per query and closes it in a finally block. Removed unused PGliteInstance interface from types.ts and an obsolete cleanup method.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: types.ts cleaned up unused interface; turbo.json added an unrelated concurrency limit increase.
change_trajectory: Initial commit: refactor to per‑query instance lifecycle, remove session storage.
Maintainer removed an unnecessary cleanup method.
